# Everything about the pepper shaker / pepper shaker

![All about the pepper shaker](/uploads/43_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

With patch 28 (07/07/2021) a new weapon has been added to the game. The pepper shaker or pepper shaker (as it became known at the PTS). I already introduced the weapon in the article about the upcoming changes to the patch. Here again separately, as there are always questions about it.

## Pepper Shaker Features and Perks

The Pepper Shaker is an **automatic heavy weapon with a rotating barrel.** By default it is a type of "**shot minigun**", can be changed via mods to **fusion cells** or **plasma cartridges**.

The pepper shaker is **tradable**.

**Class**: Automatic, Heavy Weapon, Shotgun

In order to skill this weapon, you need the perk cards "**Large and Heavy**" as well as all other common perks for heavy weapons. It is also possible to skill on **shotguns**. And both in parallel.

**Magazine size**: 50 rounds

**Level**: 35 / 40 / 45 / 50

**Ammunition**: Shotgun shells, fusion cells, or plasma cartridges

**Legendary Effects**: Can drop from enemies and events, and can be crafted if the plan is known.

## Pepper shaker blueprint

The **Blueprint** only drops at the “**Meat Week**” event, but can also be traded.

The next Meat Week event will take place in 2024:

- 
(Between August - September) 2024: Meat week including second helpings (tbc)

## Legendary pepper shaker with exploding balls

The legendary version **cannot drop with exploding bullets**, otherwise you could create a new energy weapon yourself with Explo. Bethesda no longer wants to drop energy weapons with explosives in Fallout 76. However, for a while there was a very rare chance to receive a pepper shaker with Explo as a reward from the allies in the camp. (09/08/2021: No more Explo: In patch 30, the ability to drop an Explo version from a CAMP companion was removed.) 

## Pepper Shaker Mods

The **Mods** can be purchased from **Regs (Vault 79)** for gold:

- Single run (200 gold)
- Double Run (200 gold)
- Sixfold Run (200 gold)
- Gunner Visor (200 gold)
- Fusion Magazine (200 gold)
- Plasma magazine (200 gold)

The mods are also available for **Samuel (Settler)** and **Mortimer (Raider)**, but only with the **Reputation level (Allied)**. With regs you get them regardless of reputation. 

See also: Wastelanders plans among raiders / settlers listed by merchants and reputation / gold plans of all factions

## Useable Legendary Versions

The pepper shaker can be crafted legendary at the workbench. The most playable version is a quadruple pepper shaker. With the legendary quadruple effect, the magazine has 200 rounds and is easier to use with a larger magazine than with 50 rounds due to the delay in the initial rotation. Other good perks are of course a 25% higher fire rate or +25% damage when aiming, VATS effects are rather useless because the AP consumption is very high.

## Good Heavy Gunner build addition

The pepper shaker is a good addition to any heavy weapon build. Especially when it comes to crippling. This is e.g. Useful in the Scorched Earth event to get the Queen to land, but also to force normal scorch beasts to land. This works particularly well with the 2nd legendary effect “+50% body part damage” and/or the perk “Emphasis” under Agility.

See also: Fallout 76 Wiki
